words.root_logic: capit（caput 头）+ -al（属于…的）→ 居于头位的那一个
words.origin: 拉丁语 capitalis（居首的、关乎头的）← caput（头）；一国之首、一笔居首的钱、一行字里领头的字形，都从「头」分出
words.native_definition: the chief city of a country, money used to produce more money, or a large form of a letter
words.core_concept: the one that stands at the head of the rest – 处在头位的那一个
words.core_image: 地图上众多圆点里只有一个标着五角星，名单最上面一行也留给它
examples: Paris is the capital of France.
They raised capital for the new factory.
semantic_expansions: 首都：一国众多城市里排在头位的那座
资本：一笔钱被摆在头位，用来生出更多钱
大写字母：一行字里个头最大、领头的那种字形
主要的：同类之中最要紧、排第一的

words.root_logic: casual（casus 落下来的事）+ -ty（名词后缀）→ 事情落下来时被压在下面的那个人
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 casualitas（偶然事件）← 拉丁语 casualis ← casus（落下、意外）← cadere（落下）
words.native_definition: a person killed or injured in an accident, a disaster, or a war
words.core_concept: the one the falling event came down on – 落下来的那件事压到的人
words.core_image: 爆炸过后统计名单一行行拉长，每行后面写着送去哪家医院
examples: The bomb caused over thirty casualties.
Both sides suffered heavy casualties that winter.
semantic_expansions: 伤亡者：事情砸下来时正好在下面的那个人
伤亡人数：把压到的人数出来，一行一个
事故受害者：不限战场，任何落下来的意外都算

words.origin: 古法语 cherir（珍爱）← chier（亲爱的）← 拉丁语 carus（亲爱的、贵重的）；与 carrus（四轮货车）不同源，勿混
words.native_definition: to hold someone or something dear and look after them carefully
words.core_concept: holding a thing dear enough to guard it – 拿它当贵重的，看着护着
words.core_image: 一张旧照片夹在书里，边角磨白了还用软布垫着，搬几次家都没丢
examples: She cherished the letters from her mother.
We cherish the memory of that summer.
semantic_expansions: 珍爱：把人或物看得贵重，肯花心思待它
珍藏：贵重到要收起来，不轻易拿出
怀有：心里长久揣着一个念头或愿望
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 中古英语 bordure ← 古法语 bordeure（边饰）← bord（边、船舷）← 法兰克语 *bord（板、边），与古英语 bord（板）同支
words.native_definition: the line where one country or area ends and the next begins
words.core_concept: the edge where one thing stops and the next starts – 一样东西到头、下一样开头的那条边
words.core_image: 两国之间一道白线横过公路，一侧车牌全换了颜色，护照要拿出来
examples: They crossed the border at dawn.
France borders Spain in the south.
semantic_expansions: 边界：两片地之间划出来的那条线，过线要验证件
边缘：一块布或一页纸最外的一圈
镶边：沿最外一圈加上的一道装饰
毗邻：两块地共用那条线，也就是挨着
words.decomposable_note: 早期借词，经古英语或中古英语阶段传入，词形已归化，无可拆的词缀

words.origin: 法语 bureaucratie：bureau（写字台、办公室）← 古法语 burel（铺台面的粗毛呢）← 晚期拉丁语 burra（粗毛）；后半 -cratie ← 希腊语 kratos（权力），与 demos（民众）一支不同根
words.native_definition: a system of government or management run by many officials following fixed rules
words.core_concept: power that sits with the desks and their rules – 权力落在一排写字台和它们的规矩上
words.core_image: 一份申请在七张写字台之间挨个盖章，少一个红印就退回重来
examples: The bureaucracy delayed his visa for months.
She complained about hospital bureaucracy.
semantic_expansions: 官僚机构：一层层办公桌搭起来的那套管事班子
官僚作风：办事只认规矩不认事，推来推去
繁琐程序：一道章接一道章，走完要很久
words.decomposable_note: 希腊借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 美洲西班牙语 cafetería（卖咖啡的铺子）← café ← 法语 café ← 意大利语 caffè ← 土耳其语 kahve ← 阿拉伯语 qahwa（咖啡）
words.native_definition: a restaurant where you collect your own food at a counter and carry it to a table
words.core_concept: a place where you fetch your own tray – 自己端着盘子取食的地方
words.core_image: 端着托盘沿柜台一路挪，看中哪样自己夹，末端结账再找位子坐
examples: We ate lunch in the school cafeteria.
The hospital cafeteria closes at eight.
semantic_expansions: 自助餐厅：吃的摊在柜台上，取多少自己拿
食堂：机关学校里供人吃饭的那间大屋
words.decomposable_note: 借自阿拉伯语，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 拉丁语 candidatus（穿白袍的人）← candidus（雪白的）← candere（发白光）；罗马求官的人穿白托加站到人前
words.native_definition: a person who is trying to be chosen for a job, a position, or a prize
words.core_concept: the one standing out in white to be picked – 穿得雪白站出来等人挑的那个
words.core_image: 一群人穿着刚漂过的白袍站在广场上，谁都想让人一眼先看见自己
examples: Three candidates are running for mayor.
Each candidate gave a short speech.
semantic_expansions: 候选人：站出来让众人挑的那一个
候补者：名字排在单子上，等位子腾出来
应试者：来受考、听人挑选的人
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: capital（caput 头 → 居首的那笔钱）+ -ism（一套体制）→ 以那笔钱为轴心转起来的体制
words.origin: 英语 capital 加 -ism，十九世纪中期造词；capital ← 拉丁语 capitalis ← caput（头）
words.native_definition: an economic system in which businesses and property are privately owned and run for profit
words.core_concept: a system built around privately held money that must grow – 以私人手里那笔钱的增长为轴的体制
words.core_image: 工厂、店铺、田地都记在私人名下，谁投的钱多谁说话，年底看账上多出多少
examples: Capitalism rewards those who take business risks.
He wrote a long critique of capitalism.

words.origin: 古法语 carpite ← 中世纪拉丁语 carpita（拆绒织成的厚呢）← 拉丁语 carpere（拉扯、梳绒）
words.native_definition: a thick woven covering for a floor
words.core_concept: pulled wool woven thick and spread on the floor – 拆下来的绒毛织厚了摊在地上
words.core_image: 整间屋子的地板被一层厚绒遮住，光脚踩下去陷半分，脚步声也闷了
examples: They laid a new carpet in the hall.
Fallen leaves carpeted the whole path.
semantic_expansions: 地毯：铺在地板上的那层厚绒织物
铺满：像那层绒一样把地面整片盖住
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 法语 cassette（小盒）← 古法语 casse（箱）← 拉丁语 capsa（箱、匣）；本项目未为 capsa 一支建根
words.native_definition: a small flat plastic case holding magnetic tape for recording sound or pictures
words.core_concept: a little box with the tape wound inside – 一只小盒，带子绕在里头
words.core_image: 巴掌大的塑料扁盒，两个齿轮中间绷着一条褐色带子，按下去就转
examples: He still keeps a box of cassettes.
She pushed the cassette into the player.
semantic_expansions: 盒式磁带：把磁带装进小盒，整盒取放
小盒：原义就是一只盛东西的小匣
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 拉丁语 categoria ← 希腊语 katēgoria（指称、断言）← katēgorein：kata-（对着）＋ agorein（在集会上发言）
words.native_definition: a group of people or things that share the same features
words.core_concept: one name called out over a whole group – 对着一群东西叫出的那个名目
words.core_image: 报名表按项目分成几摞，每摞里的人条件相似，新来的先看归哪摞
examples: Books are shelved by category here.
This film won in three categories.
semantic_expansions: 类别：按共同特征分出来的那一摞
范畴：讨论时框定的一个大类
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 拉丁语 cautio（提防、担保）← cavere（当心、警惕），过去分词 cautus
words.native_definition: great care taken to avoid danger or mistakes, or to warn someone about them
words.core_concept: watching out before the step goes down – 落脚之前先看清
words.core_image: 脚下是薄冰，每一步先用鞋尖压一压，听见响就把脚收回来
examples: Handle the glass with great caution.
Police cautioned him about his speed.
semantic_expansions: 谨慎：动作之前先掂量，宁慢不错
小心：留着一分注意力在危险那头
警告：把该提防的地方指给别人
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 拉丁语 celebritas（人多、盛况、声名）← celeber（人来人往的、众口传说的）
words.native_definition: a famous person, or the state of being famous
words.core_concept: the crowd that gathers where a name is known – 名字一出口就有人围过来
words.core_image: 一个人刚下车，四周举起的手机把他围成一圈，谁都叫得出他是谁
examples: The party was full of celebrities.
He never wanted this kind of celebrity.
semantic_expansions: 名人：走到哪里都被围住认出的那个
名声：名字被许多人念着的那种状态
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古法语 chalenge（指控、争辩）← 拉丁语 calumnia（诬告、刁难）← calvi（欺骗）
words.native_definition: something difficult that tests your ability, or to question or invite someone to compete
words.core_concept: a claim thrown at you that must be answered – 有人把一句话丢过来，你得应下
words.core_image: 有人当面把话丢过来要你接住，接了就得拿出真本事，退一步也被看见
examples: The new job was a real challenge.
She challenged his version of events.
semantic_expansions: 挑战：被人当面叫住，要你比一比
质疑：把对方的说法当场提出来问
艰难任务：难度顶在前头，得使足力气
words.decomposable_note: 经法语入英语的借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 希腊语 charaktēristikos ← charaktēr（打上的印记）← charassein（刻、划）
words.native_definition: a feature that belongs to someone or something and helps you identify them
words.core_concept: the mark cut in that tells one from another – 刻上去的那道印，凭它认出是谁
words.core_image: 一枚印子按在陶坯上，凹痕的形状旁人仿不出，一看就知出自谁手
examples: Patience is a characteristic of good teachers.
He answered with characteristic calm.
semantic_expansions: 特征：能把这一个从同类里认出来的那一点
特有的：只在它身上出现，别处没有
典型的：与它一贯的样子对得上
words.decomposable_note: 希腊借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 法语 chimiste ← 中世纪拉丁语 alchimista（炼金术士）← 阿拉伯语 al-kīmiyā（炼金之术）
words.native_definition: a scientist who studies substances and how they react, or a shop selling medicines
words.core_concept: one who works at how substances turn into others – 专门摆弄物质变化的人
words.core_image: 台面上一排玻璃器皿，两种清水倒在一起忽然变绿，他低头记下时刻
examples: The chemist tested the water sample.
Buy the tablets at the chemist.
semantic_expansions: 化学家：研究物质怎样相互变化的人
药剂师：按方子配药的人
药店：英式说法里也指卖药的那间铺子
words.decomposable_note: 借自阿拉伯语，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 西班牙语 chocolate ← 纳瓦特尔语 xocolātl（可可豆做的饮料）
words.native_definition: a sweet brown food made from cacao beans
words.core_concept: ground cacao pressed into a dark block – 可可磨碎压成的深褐块
words.core_image: 一块深褐的方砖捏在手里就发软，掰断时脆响，入口先苦后甜
examples: She ate a whole bar of chocolate.
He wore a chocolate brown coat.
semantic_expansions: 巧克力：可可豆磨浆加糖压成的那种甜食
巧克力色：那块砖的颜色，深而偏红的褐
words.decomposable_note: 借自西班牙语，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: co-（一同）+ in-（落到上头）+ cid（cadere 落下）+ -ence → 两件事同时落到一个点上
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 coincidere：co-（一同）＋ incidere（落到某处上头）← cadere（落下）
words.native_definition: the chance happening of two things at the same time or place
words.core_concept: two things falling on the same point – 两件事落在同一个点上
words.core_image: 两人在异国同一节车厢里碰上，谁都没约，票是各自买的
examples: Meeting you here is a strange coincidence.
By coincidence we chose the same hotel.
semantic_expansions: 巧合：两件不相干的事恰好落到一处
同时发生：两者在同一刻一起落下

words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 combinatio ← combinare：com-（一同）＋ bini（两个两个地）；本项目未为 bini 一支建根
words.native_definition: a joining of two or more things, or the result of joining them
words.core_concept: two taken two by two into one – 两个两个地凑到一处
words.core_image: 两股细线搓成一股，谁也拆不开；锁上三个数字按对次序才弹开
examples: The dish is a combination of spices.
He forgot the combination to the safe.
semantic_expansions: 结合：两样东西并到一处成一样
组合：几件按某种搭配摆在一起
密码：几个数字按定好的次序凑成一串
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古英语 betwēonum：be（在）＋ tweonum（成双的）← 原始日耳曼语 *twihna（两个一组）
words.native_definition: in the space, time, or range that separates two people or things
words.core_concept: in the gap that two things leave – 落在两者留出的那段空当里
words.core_image: 两棵树中间拉一根绳，晾的衣服全挂在这一段，两头各系一个结
examples: The shop sits between a bank and a cafe.
Choose between tea and coffee.
semantic_expansions: 在…之间：位置或时间落在两者当中
介于：性质、程度处在两者中间
collocations: between A and B —— 在两者之间，两端都要点明，不能只说一头
between you and me —— 你我之间说说，表示别外传
in between —— 夹在中间，可单用作副词
between 与 among —— between 用于分得清的两个或几个，among 用于混作一片的一群
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 英语 break（古英语 brecan 折断）＋ down（古英语 dūne 向下）复合，十九世纪成词
words.native_definition: a failure of a machine, a relationship, or health, or a division of something into parts
words.core_concept: something giving way and coming apart – 一样东西撑不住，散开了
words.core_image: 货车停在路肩不动了，机盖掀开冒白气；另一张纸上把总数拆成一条条
examples: The car had a breakdown on the motorway.
Give me a breakdown of the costs.
semantic_expansions: 故障：机器撑不住，当场停下
崩溃：人的身体或关系散了架
分项细目：把整块拆成一条一条摆开
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 英语 brief（文书）＋ case（箱）复合；brief ← 拉丁语 brevis（短的、简短文书），case ← 拉丁语 capsa（箱），本项目未为这两支建根
words.native_definition: a flat stiff case with a handle, used for carrying documents
words.core_concept: a stiff flat box for carrying papers – 装文书的硬扁箱
words.core_image: 一只扁而硬的皮箱提在手里，扣子一按弹开，里面竖着几叠纸
examples: He snapped his briefcase shut.
She carried a black leather briefcase.
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古英语 buttorflēoge：buttor（黄油）＋ flēoge（飞虫）；何以得名无定论，一说其粪色如黄油
words.native_definition: an insect with large coloured wings that flies by day
words.core_concept: wide patterned wings opening and closing in daylight – 白天里一开一合的两片花翅
words.core_image: 两片带斑纹的薄翅在花上一开一合，落下时几乎不压弯花瓣
examples: A butterfly landed on her wrist.
He swims butterfly better than freestyle.
semantic_expansions: 蝴蝶：白天飞的那种宽翅带斑纹的虫
蝶泳：两臂同时向后划，像那对翅膀开合的泳姿
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 中古英语 cart ← 古诺斯语 kartr（两轮车），取代了古英语 cræt；与拉丁语 carrus（四轮货车）无关
words.native_definition: a small vehicle with wheels for carrying goods, pushed or pulled
words.core_concept: a wheeled board you push or pull yourself – 装了轮子的板，靠人推拉
words.core_image: 两个木轮架着一块板，装满土豆后要弯腰使劲推，石子路上咯咯响
examples: He pushed the cart up the hill.
They carted the bricks to the site.
semantic_expansions: 手推车：靠人推着走的小车
大车：牲口拉的两轮货车
用车运：把东西装上车拉走
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.root_logic: cata-（往下）+ log（logos 说、逐条列举）→ 一条一条往下说，说成一份单子
words.origin: 希腊语 katalogos（清单）← katalegein：kata-（往下）＋ legein（说、逐条列举）
words.native_definition: a complete list of items, often with descriptions, or to make such a list
words.core_concept: saying items down one by one into a list – 一条一条往下报，报成一份单子
words.core_image: 一本厚册子，每页十几条，每条配一张小图和一个编号，翻到哪页都对得上
examples: She ordered the coat from a catalog.
They catalogued every book in the room.
semantic_expansions: 目录：按次序列出的条目单
产品名录：卖家把货一条条列出来的册子
编入目录：把一样东西加进那份单子里

words.origin: 英语 chair（座椅）＋ man（人）复合；chair ← 古法语 chaiere ← 拉丁语 cathedra ← 希腊语 kathedra：kata-（向下）＋ hedra（座）
words.native_definition: the person who leads a meeting or heads a company's board
words.core_concept: the one who holds the seat at the head – 坐在头把座椅上的那个人
words.core_image: 长桌一头那把带扶手的椅子只留给一个人，他一敲桌面全场就静下来
examples: The chairman opened the meeting at nine.
She was elected chairman last spring.
semantic_expansions: 主席：占着头把座椅、说话定调的人
董事长：公司董事会里坐那把椅子的
会议主持人：负责让会按次序走下去的人
words.decomposable_note: 希腊借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 英语 check 的英式拼法，受法语 chèque 影响 ← 古法语 eschec（棋局上的将）← 阿拉伯语 šāh ← 波斯语 šāh（王）；核对以防篡改一义出自「将住」那一截
words.native_definition: a printed form on which you write an amount to be paid from your bank account
words.core_concept: a slip that stops money and sends it on – 一张纸条把账上的钱截住，转给别人
words.core_image: 一张印好格线的纸条，填上数目签个名撕下来，对方拿去银行才取到钱
examples: He wrote a cheque for two hundred pounds.
The cheque bounced last Friday.
words.decomposable_note: 经法语入英语的借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 中古英语 claspe（金属搭扣），或为 clapse 的音位换位，与古英语 clyppan（抱紧）一支有关；更早词源不明
words.native_definition: a small fastening that holds two parts together, or to hold something tightly
words.core_concept: two parts biting shut and not letting go – 两边咬住就不松
words.core_image: 项链两端那个小铁件咔一声咬住，扳不开；也像手指把硬币攥进掌心
examples: The clasp on her necklace broke.
He clasped her hand tightly.
semantic_expansions: 扣子：把两头咬合住的小金属件
紧握：手指合上不放松
搂抱：两臂像那副扣件一样合住人
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 英语 clock（钟）＋ -wise（古英语 wīse 方式）；clock ← 中古荷兰语 clocke ← 中世纪拉丁语 clocca（钟、铃）
words.native_definition: in the direction that the hands of a clock move
words.core_concept: following the way the hands go round – 跟着钟面指针转的那个方向
words.core_image: 旋盖时手腕从上往右压，跟着表面那根长针走的方向，反过来就松了
examples: Turn the lid clockwise to close it.
The dancers moved clockwise around the fire.
semantic_expansions: 顺时针方向：与钟面指针一致的那个转向
顺时针的：形容按那个方向转的动作
words.decomposable_note: 早期借词，经古英语或中古英语阶段传入，词形已归化，无可拆的词缀

words.origin: 古英语 clyster（一簇、一串）← 原始日耳曼语中与 clot（凝块）同支的词干
words.native_definition: a small close group of things or people of the same kind
words.core_concept: things bunched tight on one stem – 挤在一根梗上的那一把
words.core_image: 葡萄一颗挨一颗挤在同一根梗上，摘的时候整把拎起来，谁也不单独掉
examples: A cluster of houses stood by the river.
Reporters clustered around the entrance.
semantic_expansions: 簇：同类的东西紧挨成一小把
群：几个人或物凑在一小片地方
聚集：往一处挤拢的那个动作
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.root_logic: com-（一起）+ plic（plicare 折叠）+ -ated → 好几层折在一起，抖不开也数不清
words.origin: 拉丁语 complicatus（折叠起来的）← complicare：com-（一起）＋ plicare（折叠）
words.native_definition: made of many connected parts and therefore hard to understand or deal with
words.core_concept: folded over on itself many times – 自己折了好几层在一起
words.core_image: 一团耳机线在口袋里绕成一坨，抽哪一头都带起另外三处结
examples: The rules are far too complicated.
This makes my job more complicated.
semantic_expansions: 复杂的：层层折叠，一眼看不到底
难处理的：折在一起，牵一处动全身
